metadata.title: Louis Rossmann, FUTO, FULU, and the Consumer Rights Wiki - seventeen years of repair advocacy into digital-ownership lawfare
metadata.frame: Rossmann: NY shop + YouTube + decade of R2R testimony, then FUTO community outreach (2022-Feb 2025, funded by Eron Wolf), then FULU 501(c)(4) with Kevin O'Reilly (Jun 2025) running DMCA 1201 bounties and the Consumer Rights Wiki (Jan 2025; consumerrights.wiki). FUTO funded him; he did not fund FUTO. Own Your Shit tour summer 2026 (WIRED 17 Sep). Overlay; excluded from proofs.
metadata.status: shop/org/testimony/wiki stats/tour = fact; strawman-security line = documented advocacy except where primaries already cut that way (NHTSA, FTC)

edges.notes: Shop owner + YouTube diagnostics (~2.6M) turned into legislative testimony (NY Digital Fair Repair Act 2015-22; Nebraska LB67 2017) and ongoing R2R lobbying via Repair Preservation Group Action Fund (fact).
Founder and exec director of Repair Preservation Group (501c3 education / repair.wiki) plus the Action Fund 501c4 that lobbies R2R bills (fact, his site).

Director of Community Outreach 2022-Feb 2025; shop moved to Austin. FUTO (Eron Wolf, for-profit) funded the work - inverted 'Rossmann funds FUTO' claim is false. Wolf donated on the order of $1M to Rossmann's nonprofit before hiring him (Rossmann's own comment) (fact of the job and funder direction; $1M is his figure).
Founded FUTO 2021; sole owner/funder; Yahoo Games-era capital. No SV/government/NGO investment (fact, FUTO FAQ/About).

Co-founded FULU Foundation USA (Freedom from Unethical Limitations on Users) with Kevin O'Reilly, June 2025; 501c4 for digital ownership and DMCA 1201 reform. Distinct from the for-profit shop (fact).
Co-founder with Rossmann (fact, Wikipedia + FULU materials).

Hosts consumerrights.wiki (moved from wiki.rossmanngroup.com). Launched Jan 2025 as Consumer Action Taskforce Wiki. About page: 1,472 articles, 206 active contributors (2026). Advocacy database, not a court (fact of hosting and counts).

Bounty program (bounties.fulu.org) pays for restoring function on DRM-locked/bricked devices (Nest, Molekule, Xbox optical, Echelon bikes $20k). Intended as legislative evidence. 1201 makes sharing unlocks legally hazardous - legality of any given unlock not asserted (fact of the program).
R2R asks OEMs for parts/tools; FULU is the self-help twin plus 1201 reform. Own Your Shit tour summer 2026 (WIRED 17 Sep 2026) with 1201 postcards to representatives (fact of the tour).
Institutional R2R cohort (guides, parts, state-law tracker) networked with Rossmann's shop-advocacy line. Same fight, different vehicles (fact of shared campaign space; no payroll asserted).
